title: Pocketwire Business Profile Seller Rate Card: Transaction and Cross-Border Rates
content:
Seller transaction fees on the Pocketwire Business Profile are priced per tier. Each rate has a percentage part, taken on the sale amount, and a fixed part in US dollars. Column headings abbreviate the six tiers of the Pocketwire Business Profile: Pocketwire Business Starter, Pocketwire Business Essentials, Pocketwire Business Growth, Pocketwire Business Pro, Pocketwire Business Premier and Pocketwire Business Enterprise.

## Channel rates

| | Starter | Essentials | Growth | Pro | Premier | Enterprise |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| In-app and online-checkout sale, percentage | 2.99% | 2.69% | 2.49% | 2.29% | 1.99% | 1.79% |
| In-app and online-checkout sale, fixed part | USD 0.49 | USD 0.49 | USD 0.39 | USD 0.30 | USD 0.30 | USD 0.25 |
| In-person QR-code sale, percentage | 1.90% | 1.90% | 1.79% | 1.69% | 1.49% | 1.29% |
| In-person QR-code sale, fixed part | USD 0.10 | USD 0.10 | USD 0.10 | USD 0.10 | USD 0.10 | USD 0.05 |
| Tap-to-pay card-present sale, percentage | 2.60% | 2.60% | 2.50% | 2.40% | 2.29% | 2.19% |
| Tap-to-pay card-present sale, fixed part | USD 0.15 | USD 0.15 | USD 0.15 | USD 0.10 | USD 0.10 | USD 0.10 |
| Sale paid through a Pocketwire invoice, percentage | 3.49% | 3.49% | 3.29% | 2.99% | 2.79% | 2.59% |
| Sale paid through a Pocketwire invoice, fixed part | USD 0.49 | USD 0.49 | USD 0.49 | USD 0.49 | USD 0.49 | USD 0.49 |

## Micropayment rate

| | Starter | Essentials | Growth | Pro | Premier | Enterprise |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Micropayment threshold (sale amount below which the micropayment rate replaces the channel rate) | USD 10.00 | USD 10.00 | USD 10.00 | USD 10.00 | USD 10.00 | USD 10.00 |
| Micropayment rate, percentage | 4.99% | 4.99% | 4.99% | 4.49% | 3.99% | 3.99% |
| Micropayment rate, fixed part | USD 0.09 | USD 0.09 | USD 0.09 | USD 0.09 | USD 0.09 | USD 0.09 |

## Cross-border rate

| | Starter | Essentials | Growth | Pro | Premier | Enterprise |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Additional fee on a sale from a buyer outside the United States, percentage of the sale amount | 1.50% | 1.50% | 1.50% | 1.25% | 1.00% | 0.75% |

The cross-border rate has no fixed part.

## Notes to the rate card

- The threshold is a strict "below": a sale of exactly USD 10.00 is priced at its channel rate, and a sale of USD 9.99 at the micropayment rate.
- The same fixed part applies to invoice sales on every tier (USD 0.49), and the micropayment fixed part is USD 0.09 on every tier.
- Reading across a row: an in-app sale on Pocketwire Business Premier carries 1.99% plus USD 0.30, while the same sale on Pocketwire Business Starter carries 2.99% plus USD 0.49.
